description.zh: 按广告配置名称查询，支持模糊匹配
description.en: The configuration name. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 数据抓取参数，获取后续数据的最大记录数，使用此方式获取数据时分页参数将无效，默认为10
description.en: The maximum number of entries to retrieve in a subsequent request. If this parameter is used, the pagination parameters become invalid. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 数据抓取参数，获取后续数据的token，使用此方式获取数据时分页参数将无效
description.en: The token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If this parameter is used, the pagination parameters become invalid.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 分页参数，排序方式，asc:按创建时间升序，desc:按创建时间降序
description.en: The sorting order of the configurations by creation time. asc: ascending. desc: descending.

title.zh: 获取广告插入配置列表
